title: Uniform-excess contraction on nonbipartite graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ with a nonempty vertex set. Suppose $G$ is connected and nonbipartite, and $D\le |V|^5$, where $|V|$ is the number of vertices. For every rational-valued function $p$ on the vertices whose values sum to $1$, the distribution after $2|V|$ steps has uniform excess at most $\left(1-1/|V|^{10|V|}\right)$ times the uniform excess of $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ has a finite, nonempty vertex set
$G$ is a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
$p$ is rational-valued and its values sum to $1$
